scope: Revision-B electrical design authority: logical connectivity, exact selected components, GPIO ownership, power limits and firmware hardware contract. No ECAD/ERC/PCB/DRC/fabrication claim.

logical_architecture.encoders: 5 direct quadrature A/B pairs; no encoder push switches
logical_architecture.rgb: one IS31FL3741A, 107 common-cathode RGB packages, 13 RGB slots per SW scan line, powered by a dedicated TPS61023 RGB_5V1 boost rail
logical_architecture.usb: USB 2.0 device-only Type-C receptacle, two Rd resistors, data ESD, dedicated RP2040 USB PHY
logical_architecture.power: VBUS -> TPS2553DBVR-1 latch-off current limiter -> SYS_5V; SYS_5V -> TLV75533PDBVR -> 3V3; SYS_5V -> always-enabled TPS61023DRLR -> RGB_5V1; IS31FL3741A SDB has 100 kOhm pull-down so LEDs remain hardware-off until GP28 enables them. Keeping the boost rail present avoids 3V3 I2C pull-ups back-powering an unpowered RGB driver.
logical_architecture.illustrative_status_leds: NOT_POPULATED_E01: the three RK_STATUS_* Blender meshes have no electrical ownership in E01 and consume no GPIO. Add only through a later netlist revision.
